name: ai-dev-team
description: Small standalone Claude Code plugins: guardrails, review, spec-upkeep, test-quality and metrics.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Git pre-commit secret and comment checks, Claude Code hooks that apply them while Claude edits, and a scoped test runner that prints only totals and failures.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Proven code review: review-bolt and sweep-area run the review, prove-findings keeps only findings a failing test proves, mutate-check shows a regression test guards its line, and design-critic attacks risky designs before coding.

plugins.name: spec-upkeep
plugins.description: Reports stale file paths, symbols, commands and links cited in project docs, and the check-docs skill fixes them to match the code.

plugins.name: test-quality
plugins.description: Flags decorative new tests with the test-critic agent, maps acceptance criteria to tests, and lists a branch's new tests and criteria with scripts.

plugins.name: metrics
plugins.description: Records one CSV row per merged PR with time to merge, review counts and token use from Claude Code session logs.
